definitions.explanation: Dressing up in a costume to look like someone or something else, for entertainment, festivals, or events. Includes Halloween costumes, costume parties, and parade costumes.
Concealing one's true identity or the true nature of something by changing outward appearance.

examples.japanese: ハロウィンに{仮装|かそう}する。
examples.english: To wear a costume for Halloween.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{魔女|まじょ}やお{化|ば}けに{仮装|かそう}して{街|まち}を{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: The children dressed up as witches and ghosts and walked through town.

examples.japanese: {仮装|かそう}{行列|ぎょうれつ}はお{祭|まつ}りの{目玉|めだま}イベントだ。
examples.english: The costume parade is the highlight event of the festival.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{警備員|けいびいん}に{仮装|かそう}して{建物|たてもの}に{侵入|しんにゅう}した。
examples.english: The culprit disguised himself as a security guard and entered the building.

examples.japanese: {密輸品|みつゆひん}は{一般|いっぱん}{貨物|かもつ}に{仮装|かそう}されていた。
examples.english: The smuggled goods were disguised as regular cargo.

examples.japanese: {仮装|かそう}した{敵|てき}のスパイを{見破|みやぶ}るのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It is difficult to see through a disguised enemy spy.

notes: Used with する to form {仮装|かそう}する (to dress up in costume, to disguise). Common collocations: {仮装|かそう}{大会|たいかい} (costume contest), {仮装|かそう}{行列|ぎょうれつ} (costume parade), {仮装|かそう}パーティー (costume party). With the growing popularity of Halloween in Japan, {仮装|かそう} has become strongly associated with Halloween costumes. Homophones: {仮想|かそう} (virtual, hypothetical), {火葬|かそう} (cremation), {下層|かそう} (lower stratum) — all different words. Related: コスプレ (cosplay — dressing as specific characters), {変装|へんそう} (disguise — specifically to conceal identity).
